data.ten: EN3113 - Quản lý và Kỹ thuật Xử lý Đất ô nhiễm
data.ten_eng: EN3113 - Contaminated Soil Remediation Engineering and Management
data.thongtinchung:
{"bacDaoTao":{"id":2,"ma":"DH","ten":{"vi":"Đại học","en":"Undergraduate"}},"loaiMonHoc":{"id":21,"ma":"CN","ten":{"vi":"Chuyên Ngành"}},"mucTieuMonHoc":{"vi":"

Môn học cung cấp cho sinh viên các kiến thức về môi trường đất, hiện trạng sử dụng và các nguyên nhân làm ô nhiễm và suy thoái môi trường đất. Giúp sinh viên nắm được các công nghệ xử lý ô nhiễm đất thường gặp và đề xuất các biện pháp quản lý các nguồn ô nhiễm đất.

","en":"

This course provide students advanced knowledge of soil environment and soil contamination for management approaches and remediation solutions.

"},"noiDungTomTatMonHoc":{"vi":"

Nội dung môn học bao gồm những kiến thức tổng quát về môi trường đất, các hoạt động và tác nhân gây suy thoái và ô nhiễm đất, ý nghĩa và ứng dụng của các giải pháp quản lý và xử lý ô nhiễm đất.

","en":"

The subject includes knowledge about environmental soil chemistry, sources of soil contaminants, management approaches and remediation technologies.

"},"taiLieuHocTap":{"vi":"

[1]. Blanco H. and Lal R., Principles of Soil Conservation and Management. Springer, 2008 

[2]. Jannoyer M. L. et al., Crisis Management of Chronic Pollution – Contaminated Soil and Human Health, CRC Press, 2017. 

[3]. Mirsal I., Soil Pollution – Origin, Monitoring and Remediation, Springer-Verlag Berlin Heidelberg, 2008. 

[4]. Chen F. H. (Fu Hua), Soil Engineering – Testing, Design and Remediation, CRC Press, 2000. 

[5]. Suthersan S. S., et al., Remediation Engineering- Design Concepts, Second Edition, CRC Press, 2016. 

","en":"

[1]. Blanco H. and Lal R., Principles of Soil Conservation and Management. Springer, 2008

[2]. Jannoyer M. L. et al., Crisis Management of Chronic Pollution – Contaminated Soil and Human Health, CRC Press, 2017.

[3]. Mirsal I., Soil Pollution – Origin, Monitoring and Remediation, Springer-Verlag Berlin Heidelberg, 2008.

[4]. Chen F. H. (Fu Hua), Soil Engineering – Testing, Design and Remediation, CRC Press, 2000.

[5]. Suthersan S. S., et al., Remediation Engineering- Design Concepts, Second Edition, CRC Press, 2016.


"},"huongDanCachHoc":{"vi":"

Tài liệu được đưa lên BKEL hàng tuần. Sinh viên tải về, in ra và mang theo khi lên lớp học. Điểm tổng kết môn học được đánh giá qua 3 cột điểm: Điểm bài tập (20%); Thuyết trình (30%) và điểm thi cuối kỳ (50%).
Sinh viên được yêu cầu phải tham dự giờ giảng trên lớp ít nhất 70% (số lần được điểm danh chuyên cần). Ngoài ra, sinh viên phải hoàn thành tất cả bài tập về nhà đúng hạn.

","en":"

The documents will be uploaded to BKEL. Students are required to download and print before class. The final score will be determined throughout the course: 

• Exercise (in class, homework, attendance): 20% 

• Presentation/Project: 30% 

• Final exam: 50% 

Final exam requirements: Students must participate at least 70% of class period. Students is required to finish all the homework on time. This is the prerequisites to accomplish this course. Plagiarism is strictly prohibited.

"},"ghiChu":"{"vi":"

\n\nLý thuyết: 3 tiết/buổi x 1 buổi/tuần\n\n

","en":"

Lecture time: 3 hours/lecture x 1 lecture/week
